description: Overlay an EXISTING image/logo OR a text caption on the timeline at a specific point. For an image, pass imageId (already in the project — url auto-resolved) or a direct url; for text, pass `text`. position is percent-of-canvas (0-100) from the top-left. Blocked in read-only mode.

fontColor.description: Text color, e.g. #FFFFFF. Text overlays only.

fontSize.description: Text size in px. Text overlays only.

imageId.description: Project image id to overlay (url auto-resolved).

size.description: Image scale factor 0-1. Image overlays only.

startTime.description: Seconds from the start of the movie. Default 0.

text.description: Text caption — provide instead of an image for a text overlay.

name: add_timeline_overlay
title: Add an image/logo or text overlay to the timeline
